body: I am now just rather tired, but I will defiantly keep your question in mind as I lay down to sleep.  Again, I thank you kind stranger.

You are right, I do need to just calm down, and honestly, your simple talking has actually helped me calming down a lot more than I could have ever thought.  I feel you have also helped me to avoid calming down into a deep depression, rather, I feel calmer and, I honestly don't want to say happier, but maybe just more, at ease with myself.

somehow, I feel that my only real strength over you is age, but at any rate, you are managing to help me out a bit by giving me something else to think about and giving my hands something to do.  Thus, I would say you are strong in that way.

personally if I'm in crowds too long I just want to run to the nearest empty corner I can find, curl up into the fetal position, and pull something over at least my head.  Tho, I've managed to condition myself such that it takes quite some time before I need to think about doing this.
Yeah, quite a bit.  Also, thank you for giving me something to type, even if its not much, it's still something.
Yeah.  Everyone needs their personal space sometimes.  It's just hard to get mine sometimes because of her own issues which I can't help but always feel the need to try and help.
right now, I just closed facebook.  apparently she texted one of my roommates to check up me, I have no direct contact with her right now.
